scoring_justification: Full DFT recompute is infeasible within the verifier sandbox; compare submitted numeric tables against paper gold with tolerances.

outputs.description: Computed on-site Hubbard U parameters for the RE localized orbitals. Columns: compound (La, Ce, Pr, Nd), U_type ('d' or 'f'), U_value (float in eV).
LSDA+U equilibrium lattice constants. Columns: compound (La, Ce, Pr, Nd), method (e.g. LSDA+U), a (float Å), c (float Å), volume (float Å^3).

Spin magnetic moments from LSDA+U+SO calculations. Columns: compound (Ce, Pr, Nd; La optional), method, total_moment (float μ_B), RE1_moment (float μ_B), RE2_moment (float μ_B), Ge_moment (float μ_B).

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform DFT calculations using an open-source code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO) capable of LSDA, LSDA+U, spin-orbit coupling, and the Madsen–Novák linear-response Hubbard U method. Crystal structures are provided in the instruction. The checker compares submitted CSV values against paper-reported results within appropriate tolerances to account for code-to-code spread.
